text.what: Cuttings Josh Jensen is said to have brought back from Burgundy in the mid-1970s, planted on Mount Harlan and passed around California since. Growers who plant it say so on the label.
text.story: *Tradition holds —* the cuttings came from the Domaine de la Romanée-Conti. That story is told widely, including by people who bought the plant material; documentation for the specific source is another matter.

kin.as: The vineyard it is named for.
Who carried it, by the usual account.
The practice, and its grey areas.
